name: Ambulance
description: Our 24/7 Ambulance Service is equipped with advanced life-support systems and highly trained medical personnel to ensure rapid and safe transportation for emergency patients.

name: Radiology
description: The Radiology Department offers a full spectrum of imaging services, including X-rays, ultrasound, and CT scans using the latest imaging technology.

name: Pharmacy
description: The in-house Pharmacy ensures quick and easy access to a wide range of medicines. Our licensed pharmacists are available for consultations.

name: ICU
description: Our 8-bed ICU provides critical care with advanced life-support systems, ventilator support, central monitoring, and HEPA filters to prevent cross-infections.

name: Canteen
description: Our Canteen provides a variety of healthy, nutritious meals and snacks for patients, visitors, and staff with balanced dietary options.

name: Laboratory
description: Our fully equipped Laboratory offers precise and timely diagnostic services operated by skilled technicians using state-of-the-art equipment.
